description: Offline geocoding (GeoNames + DB-IP, CC BY 4.0): exactly one of ip (IPv4/IPv6 -> country/region/city/lat,lon), q (place name, e.g. 'Springfield, IL, US', optional country filter), postcode (+country), or lat+lon (reverse: nearest places). City/place level; no street addresses. Paid ($0.001, x402).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

postcode.description: Postal code to look up; combine with country for precision

q.description: Place name; qualifiers after commas (region, country)

name: geocode
title: geocode
